title: How to Plan Realistic Deadlines for Freelance Projects
h1: How to plan realistic deadlines for freelance projects
description: Plan freelance project timelines that work: work back from launch, allow for your own reviews, buffers, dependencies, rush fees and milestone dates.
intro: Many freelance projects run late, and the cause is often not the freelancer's delivery time but everything around it: slow feedback, missing content, extra review rounds and steps that depend on each other. Rushed deadlines lead to higher fees, more mistakes and stressed collaborators. A realistic timeline accounts for all the steps, including your own. This article explains how to plan deadlines that hold.

faq.q: Is the delivery time in a package the whole project time?
faq.a: No. It covers the freelancer's work, not your reviews, revisions or preparation.

faq.q: How much buffer should I add?
faq.a: Many teams add a cushion of roughly a quarter to a third of the planned time for important projects.

faq.q: What if the freelancer misses a deadline?
faq.a: Ask early for an update, agree on a new date and check what caused the delay.
